player_prompt.intro:
Yu Player {player_id} long {num_rounds}-raun Rock-Paper-Scissors gem.
Mipela i laik yu winim planti raun i ken.
Long kila raun, yu mas tok wanpela long: '[rock]', '[paper]', o '[scissors]'.
Yu inap tu usim '[r]', '[p]', o '[s]' olsem shorthand.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Muvman i no klia. Usim [rock], [paper], o [scissors].
